**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #964, which this PR carries as its first two commits).

## What looks good
- The refusal in `fanuc-lathe.cps` `liveMove` (lines ~498-505) is a one-condition change: `rapid && !(liveCRate > 0) && |dc| > 1e-9`. It names what is missing ("states no C rate" / "a C travel but no C rate"), is raised through `refuse()` (counted warning, move not posted), and keeps #964's pinned text when a travel is stated.
- It does not touch machines that state a C rate (`speeds.normal` or `.rapid`, via the same `liveCRate` read), cut moves, rapids that turn no C, or posts without `liveTooling` (the engine already refuses C sections for them). The first-move C positioning (G00 C) is unchanged.
- The `c_axis_live` bench change is justified and shown: the bench's own contour really reached the uncapped branch, now states the `millturn.mch` figures, and every posted F is read back inside 4000 mm/min / 6000 deg/min. The no-rate case is pinned on an `unrated` copy of the same bench.
- No golden moved (nothing under `tests/golden/` in the diff). No snapshot PNGs, no process files, no new deps/build.rs/scripts. Decision file present; PR body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #966`.

## Local results (PR head merged with upstream/main bab6a0c, own target, sccache)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-app lib | 111 passed |
| c_axis_fixture / c_axis_live / c_axis_unwind | 2 / 5 / 7 passed |
| lathe_post / lathe_post_refusals / lathe_post_g76 | 7 / 6 / 8 passed |
| posting / golden_cl / pocket3d_hsm | 17 / 25 / 1 passed (1 ignored, pre-existing) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Overlap and merge order
- **#964** (d1e1245a): this head already contains #964's commits, so the diff against main includes them; merging #964 first leaves only commit 7e01f463. No conflict.
- **#951** (83cf9c6b, shared rotary feed cap): `git merge-tree` against this head is clean. #951 edits the later `fc_ = ...` cap lines of `liveMove` (replaces them with `rotaryFeedCap(...)`); this PR edits the refusal block above them, so the hunks are disjoint and the refusal still runs before the cap. Either order works. Whichever lands second should re-run `c_axis_live`, `c_axis_unwind`, `c_axis_fixture`, `rotary_feed_cap`, `lathe_post*` and `golden_cl`, since the `c_axis_live` F read-back (`assert_feeds_within`) is exactly what #951's cap changes.
- Recommended order: #964, then this PR, then #951 (or #951 any time; re-run the list above).

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- A machine that lists no rotaries at all and still reaches a C section now has its C-turning rapids refused (before: posted uncapped). That matches the intent (no stated rate), just noting it.
- `rotary_gate.rs` / `c_axis_unwind.rs` / the 906 decision file in the diff are #964's, not reviewed again here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7e01f463c3ceb63903ab1d9b317fbfe51f2c6a3a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (independent review, at the high tier: the change affects posted G-code).

This PR is stacked on #964. Its own change is commit `7e01f463`. I reviewed the whole head, merged locally with `main` at `a6bd69d8`, and the merge was clean.

### What looks good
- **The case it closes.** In a C section, a rapid after the first one is posted as a G01 at `machine.feedRateMax`, scaled by `lcmd / ltrue`. Near the spindle line that F has no bound. Now, when no C rate is stated, any such rapid that turns C (`|dc| > 1e-9`) is refused by name, with or without a C travel (`assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps:502-505`). The refusal goes through `refuse()`. `posting.rs:465` then rejects the whole program, so no partial NC is written.
- **The fix does not choose a G00 or a G01 without F.** Your decision file explains why both were dropped. The section's opening `G00 C` positioning (`:480-483`) is unchanged. It has no F and the tool is not yet at the part.
- **Rapids that do not turn C are not touched.** Moves with `dc == 0` skip the new branch, and cut moves keep their planned-chord F.
- **Machines that state a rate get the same output as before.** The rate cap at `:514` is unchanged, and no golden moved (`c_axis_helix.nc` and the two-rings golden are untouched).
- **The rate comes from one place.** The post reads it from `machine.rotaries[].speeds` (normal, then rapid). That is the same `AxisLimits.feed` / `.rapid` that `rotary_gate::c_rated` checks for #964's rewind gate, through `post::machine::mirror`. Nothing derives it a second way.
- **The message is plain English** and names what the machine file lacks, then tells the user to "state the C axis's speeds".
- **The pinning test is genuine.** It shows the contour really does link with C-turning rapids. It then shows the unrated bench is refused by name and the rated bench posts with no warnings. Every X Z C G01 is read back inside 4000 mm/min linear and 6000 deg/min C.

### Shipped machines (question 4: does anything that posted in v0.18.0 now refuse?)
No. A C section needs `tool_station.live_tool` words (`liveStart`, `:427-431`), and **no shipped `.mch` states them**. So no shipped machine could post a C section before this PR either. The shipped machines with rotaries:

| Machine file | Rotary | C rate stated |
|---|---|---|
| `millturn.mch` | C | yes: 6000 deg/min feed, 12000 deg/min rapid |
| `doosan-dnm.mch` | A | (no C) |
| `tilthead.mch` | A, B | (no C) |
| `tormach-770mx-microarc4.mch` | A | (no C) |

`lathe.mch` and the Tormach lathes state no rotaries. Only user machine files that add `live_tool` words but no C speeds change behaviour, and for those the old output was the uncapped feed this issue is about.

### Local results (merged with main `a6bd69d8`, Windows, `core.autocrlf=true`)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` | lib 16, axis_direction_cli 3, comp 9, comp_plane 3, mch_head_search 2, post_engine 33 - all pass |
| app `c_axis_unwind` | 7 pass |
| app `c_axis_live` | 5 pass |
| app `lathe_post` | 7 pass |
| app `lathe_post_refusals` | 6 pass |
| app `rotary_letter` | 3 pass |
| app `machine` | 33 pass |
| app `posting` | 17 pass |
| app `conformance` | 6 pass |
| app `golden_cl` | 25 pass |
| app lib `rotary_gate` | 6 pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (non-blocking)
1. **Merge order.** Merge #964, then this PR, then #1025. #964's head `d1e1245a` is an ancestor of this PR, and this PR's head is an ancestor of #1025. The three PRs agree in both text and intent. #1025 carries this PR's `liveMove` hunk word for word and adds its cycle-exit change elsewhere in the script. If #964 merges first, this PR reduces to its own commit. Merging this PR alone would also bring #964 in.
2. **A small error in the decision file.** `docs/decisions/966-lathe-c-no-rate.md` says `millturn.mch` is "the only built-in with live-tool words". It states C rates, but no shipped machine file has `live_tool` words. This changes nothing in the code, and you may want to fix the sentence.
3. **Cut moves are still uncapped in C when no rate is stated.** A C-section cut on such a machine posts the planned chord feed with no C cap (`:514` only applies with a rate). That is a feed the program stated, as your decision file says, so it is out of this issue's scope.
4. No snapshot PNG, process file, dependency, `build.rs`, script or `.github` change. `rotary_gate.rs` (295 lines) and the test files stay under 400 lines. The commits use conventional subjects, and the body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #966`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
